user.title: Zigbee2MQTT
user.description: Outglow reads the motion reports of Outglow bulbs from Zigbee2MQTT over MQTT. Nothing is written to the bulbs.

data_description.base_topic: The base_topic of Zigbee2MQTT, usually zigbee2mqtt

summary.title: Outglow bulbs
summary.description:
Bridge on {topic} answered. Zigbee2MQTT {version}. Found {bulbs} Outglow bulbs; motion sensing is on in {sensing}; activity reports are on in {reporting}.

Without activity reports (the device option motion_activity_rate above 0) Outglow sees only the bulbs' motion bits. Outglow does not change it for you: set it in Zigbee2MQTT if you want it. Motion tracking shows when someone moves in which room: tell the people you live with.

no_bridge.title: Zigbee2MQTT did not answer on {topic}
no_bridge.description:
Nothing came from {topic}/bridge/devices within a few seconds. Check the base topic and that Zigbee2MQTT is running. You can add Outglow anyway; it starts working when the bridge appears.

Without activity reports (the device option motion_activity_rate above 0) Outglow sees only the bulbs' motion bits. Outglow does not change it for you: set it in Zigbee2MQTT if you want it. Motion tracking shows when someone moves in which room: tell the people you live with.

abort.already_configured: Outglow is already set up for this topic
abort.mqtt_missing: Set up the MQTT integration first

init.title: Outglow
init.description: Everything else is in the Outglow panel (Settings).

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.description: Tell Outglow a room's motion was a false alarm, missed or correct.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room id or name of the plan

label.name: Label
label.description: Label the last seconds: someone was in a room, or the home was empty.

export_recording.name: Export recording
export_recording.description: Write a JSONL recording to /config/outglow/exports. It shows who was in which room and when.

include_raw.name: Include raw reports
include_raw.description: The bulbs' reports, not only labels

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Return the model to its priors; a snapshot is taken first.

write_bulb_setting.name: Write bulb setting
write_bulb_setting.description: Change a motion sensing setting in a bulb. A sensitivity overwrites every line of the bulb and clears its calibration.

rates_waiting.title: Activity rates not restored
rates_waiting.description: Outglow was removed or disabled before it could restore the activity rate of {count} bulbs, so they may still report at the raised session rate: {bulbs}. Home Assistant restores each of them once Zigbee2MQTT is online and reports its options, and only while it is still at the raised rate (a rate you changed is left as it is); a bulb counts as restored when Zigbee2MQTT reports the restored rate. It is waiting for Zigbee2MQTT now. After a restart, add or enable Outglow again (it restores them at start) or set motion_activity_rate for these bulbs in Zigbee2MQTT.

rates_not_restored.title: Activity rates not restored
rates_not_restored.description: Outglow was removed or disabled before it could restore the activity rate of {count} bulbs, so they may still report at the raised session rate: {bulbs}. Home Assistant restores each of them once Zigbee2MQTT is online and reports its options, and only while it is still at the raised rate (a rate you changed is left as it is). A failed attempt is repeated less often each time, now every {retry} min, at most every 30 min. After a restart, add or enable Outglow again (it restores them at start) or set motion_activity_rate for these bulbs in Zigbee2MQTT.

output_attribute.title: Zigbee2MQTT sends attributes, not JSON
output_attribute.description: Outglow needs advanced.output json (or attribute_and_json) in Zigbee2MQTT on {base_topic}.

bridge_offline.title: Zigbee2MQTT is offline
bridge_offline.description: The bridge on {base_topic} reports offline; motion sensing waits.

no_converter.title: Outglow converter missing
no_converter.description: {bulbs} Outglow bulbs do not show motion_links. Install outglow.mjs in Zigbee2MQTT.

no_activity_reports.title: No activity reports from {bulb}
no_activity_reports.description: {bulb} senses motion but sent no activity reports for a day. Set motion_activity_rate in Zigbee2MQTT.

plan_incomplete.title: Plan is incomplete
plan_incomplete.description: Sensing bulbs not on the plan: {bulbs}. Bulbs outside every room: {outside}.

plan_too_large.title: Plan is too large — simplify it
plan_too_large.description: Outglow does not sense with this plan until it is simpler: {problem}. Open Outglow → Plan and use fewer rooms, room corners or bulbs, or add the doors between rooms.

plan_missing.title: Draw the plan
plan_missing.description: Open Outglow → Plan and draw the rooms and the bulbs.

room_no_coverage.title: {room} is not covered
room_no_coverage.description: No pair of bulbs sees motion in {room}; its occupancy is unavailable.

recommendation_no_bulbs.title: {room} has no bulbs
recommendation_no_bulbs.description: No line crosses {room}, so motion there stays invisible. Put a bulb in it or between its neighbours. See Outglow → Quality.

recommendation_no_bulbs_rules.title: {room} has no bulbs
recommendation_no_bulbs_rules.description: Only lines crossing {room} can see motion there, and rules mode never lights a room without bulbs. See Outglow → Quality.

panel_conflict.title: The sidebar path /{path} is taken
panel_conflict.description: Another panel already uses /{path}, so the Outglow panel is not in the sidebar. Remove or rename that panel (for example a panel_custom or panel_iframe entry in configuration.yaml) and reload Outglow. Sensing and the entities work without the panel.

plan_unreadable.title: The stored plan could not be read

init.title: The stored plan could not be read
init.description:
Outglow could not read its stored plan, so it runs without rooms and keeps every room entity and device as it is. The unreadable plan is kept as {path}.

To get it back, fix that file (or put a copy from a backup in its place) and choose Restore. If you draw a new plan instead, the first saved plan with rooms replaces the old one: old rooms that are not in it are removed with their entities, and their ids are not given to new rooms.

menu_options.restore: Restore the plan from the kept file

discard.title: Discard the old plan
discard.description: Outglow forgets the old plan. These old rooms are removed with their entities, devices and learning: {rooms}. Their ids are not given to new rooms. The copy of the old plan stays in .storage.

abort.still_unreadable: {path} still cannot be read. Fix the file (or replace it with a copy from a backup) and try again.
abort.resolved: The plan is readable again; nothing to do.

session_rates_waiting.title: Activity rates not restored after a session
session_rates_waiting.description: Outglow raised the activity rate of {count} bulbs for a learning session and has been waiting more than {minutes} minutes for Zigbee2MQTT to confirm the restored rate: {bulbs}. It sends the rate again whenever Home Assistant reconnects to the MQTT broker or Zigbee2MQTT comes back online. Check that Zigbee2MQTT is running and reachable, or set motion_activity_rate for these bulbs in Zigbee2MQTT.
